title: When the Orbit Falls
author: Freya Thackeray
blurb: Wendell Oyelaran, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
